body:
## Pull request overview

This PR upgrades the console config panel UX toward an Airtable-style progressive disclosure model by adding new schema capabilities (summary rows, icons, nested subsections) and updating the renderer/layout and related tests.

**Changes:**
- Extend config-panel schema to support a new `summary` control type plus section `icon` and `subsections`.
- Update config panel UI primitives/renderers (SectionHeader, ConfigRow, ConfigPanelRenderer, ConfigFieldRenderer) to render icons, summary rows, nested subsections, and adjusted spacing.
- Add default-collapsed behavior for several View config sections and introduce a toolbar “X of Y enabled” summary chip, updating tests and i18n keys.

### Reviewed changes

`ConfigSection.subsections` is typed as recursive (`ConfigSection[]`), but the renderer only renders one level of subsections. Either render subsections recursively (so deeper nesting works), or constrain the type/API to a single nesting level to avoid a schema that can't be fully rendered.
